continuationGovernor.stopReason: The real issuedonce.shop customer journey is live-proven through encrypted shipping persistence. A downstream prepayment audit found and fixed an OpenAI image-model capability mismatch before any charge occurred: GPT Image 2 does not support the transparent background required by the production artwork contract, so the gateway now defaults to gpt-image-1.5 for transparent PNG generation and rejects gpt-image-2* overrides while alpha transparency remains required. TDD RED was observed with 112 existing test files passing and only the two new compatibility assertions failing; the fix is now fully green in CI and Browser QA. Production still contains zero payment attempts, provider events, Issues, design jobs and manufacturing jobs, so no commercial side effects occurred. The next live boundary remains Safepay sandbox credentials and webhook endpoint configuration, which cannot be written through the available connected tooling.
